## Summary

Briefly describe the change and its motivation or context.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / refactoring

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to Go formatting standards (`go fmt ./...`) and lint rules (`golangci-lint run ./...`).
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] All tests pass under the Go race detector (`go test -race ./...`).
- [ ] I have added a line under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md` following [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/).
- [ ] My commit messages adhere to [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/).
